limitations: Synthetic shortage-only simulation; no claim of Sudan utility field effectiveness or operational grid safety.
Optimization is an exact one-step objective comparator, not a global episode optimum; it observes the same causal physical state, while PPO consumes its fixed 32-value observation.
No behavior-cloning-only ablation isolates the incremental effect of PPO fine-tuning.
Zero duration disparity can coexist with uniformly bad service; read duration inequality alongside total outage burden and critical service.
Intervals are descriptive, pointwise 95% and unadjusted for multiple comparisons; seed separation does not imply independent custody or preregistration.
Forecasts remain separate from controller decisions; predictive performance is assessed only on synthetic traces.
The original accepted reproduction and 81001–81010 holdout remain unchanged; this is additional 91001–91010 evidence.

method_definitions.Optimization: Exact enumeration of all 2187 joint service-tier actions to maximize canonical one-hour reward using only current demand/supply and prior cumulative state; deterministic lowest action ID breaks ties. It is not a 24-hour optimum.
method_definitions.blackout: One modeled hour with positive locality demand above 1e-8 MW and exactly zero actual delivered power; partial service is separate.
method_definitions.critical_interruption: One modeled hour with positive critical demand above 1e-8 MW and critical served/demand below 0.99.
method_definitions.duration_gap: Within each episode: mean absolute duration difference over the 21 distinct unordered locality pairs; then equal-episode averaging.
method_definitions.longest_interruption: Maximum consecutive modeled interrupted hours per locality; episode boundaries do not wrap; aggregate is the within-episode maximum across localities.
method_definitions.ridge_ar3: 35 independent standardized ridge autoregressions using only t-3,t-2,t-1 demand, unpenalized intercept, fixed penalty 0.001 and non-negative predictions. New fit, separate from PPO and display forecast.

protocol.bootstrap_unit: base-draw cluster within seed; all three shortage variants retained
protocol.evaluation_role: newly declared synthetic extension; not independently custodied
protocol.intervals: pointwise percentile 95%; unadjusted for multiple comparisons
